results.question: When is group coaching?

reply.answer: A group coaching session takes place every Tuesday at 16:00 UTC.

results.question: How do I reset my password?

reply.answer: To reset your password, select Forgot password on the sign-in page.

results.question: How many lessons are in the Foundations course?

reply.answer: The Foundations course has 6 lessons.

results.question: How do I save my progress?

reply.answer: To save your progress, select Mark complete after finishing a lesson. Please note that watching a video alone does not mark the lesson complete.

results.question: How long does feedback on practice work take?

reply.answer: Feedback on practice work usually arrives within 2 working days, which is a typical response time rather than a guarantee.

results.question: When is support available?

reply.answer: Support is available Monday to Friday, from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.

results.question: Where do I find the link for the coaching session?

reply.answer: You can find the link for the coaching session on the Coaching page 30 minutes before the session.

results.question: How do I get feedback on my practice work?

reply.answer: To get feedback on your practice work, paste a shareable link in the Practice page and select Request feedback. Feedback usually arrives within 2 working days.

results.question: Where does my next lesson appear?

reply.answer: Your next lesson appears on Home.

results.question: Do I have to do the lessons in order?

reply.answer: No, you do not have to do the lessons in order. The Foundations course has 6 lessons, and they can be watched in any order.

results.question: When are coaching recordings added, and does watching a video mark the lesson complete?

reply.answer: Coaching recordings are added to the Coaching page within 24 hours. Watching a video alone does not mark the lesson complete; you must select Mark complete after finishing a lesson to save your progress.

results.question: A course is missing from my account. What do I do?

reply.answer: For a missing course, please contact support@brightpath.example and include your account email and the lesson name.

results.question: I watched Lesson 1 but it still says incomplete. What do I do?

reply.answer: To save your progress, select Mark complete after finishing a lesson, as watching a video alone does not mark it complete. If your lesson progress remains incorrect after doing this, please contact support at support@brightpath.example and include your account email and the lesson name.

results.question: My lesson progress is wrong. What should I do?

reply.answer: For incorrect lesson progress, please contact support@brightpath.example and include your account email and lesson name.

results.question: Can I send you my password so you can reset it for me?

reply.answer: To reset your password, you can select Forgot password on the sign-in page. Please note that you should never send your password to support.
